newsitem.title: USA: NASD bars nine representatives over testing.
newsitem.headline: NASD bars nine representatives over testing.

text.p: NASD Regulation Inc said on Tuesday it censured and barred nine individuals suspected of paying an imposter to take a qualification examination on their behalf.

Each individual was fined $25,000 for cheating on the examination, fined another $25,000 if they failed to respond and required to disgorge all commissions earned while the individual functioned in a registered capacity, up to $440,000, NASD Regulation said.
NASD said the disciplinary action was a continuation of an earlier investigation, which resulted in barring and fining 12 registered representatives.

It said the investigation was conducted by the NASD Regulation New York District Office, which identifed several individuals suspected of having paid an imposter to take a qualifying examination on their behalf.
The examination was designed to test their knowledge of the securities markets and regulations, NASD said.
NASD Regulation also said it was continuing its investigation and more disciplinary action was expected soon.
